notes: All rows have retrieved_at=2026-10-01T22:50Z. Retrieval is not the age, last update, or legal verification date of each underlying assessor fact.
Dataset names identify a DataSF 2025 roll and Boston/Cambridge FY2026 assessments; these periods are not interchangeable with a certificate-of-occupancy date.
No per-row source URL, parcel identifier or assessor-field definition is supplied in the CSV.

duplicates.note: No duplicate under these textual comparisons is not proof that every record is a distinct physical property. Street aliases, ranges, parcels, condominium interests and overlapping sites were not resolved.

notes: Blank strings are the observed missing-value representation. Present years and unit counts are syntactically integers.
No listed sentinel appears; recurring years such as 1900 are retained as supplied rather than assumed to be either verified dates or missing-value sentinels.
The unit count of 2 at A0227 needs reconciliation with its coded description; present does not mean reliable.
Year built is an annual assessor field, not first residential use, original construction history, exact completion date or certificate of occupancy.

zip_quality.caution: The prefix list identifies input consistency review candidates, not verified postal geography. No ZIP has been corrected or used to override a property location. All nonblank ZIPs pass five-digit syntax, which does not validate city/state/ZIP consistency.

address_syntax.note: Preserve original range/fraction syntax and original address_id if future geocoding normalizes street text. Do not silently replace a range with one endpoint.

postal_city_notes: Organizer README line 49 explicitly states postal_city is a mailing city, not a supplied legal jurisdiction. Identical spelling to a city name is not boundary verification.

README uses Van Nuys as a Los Angeles example, but this exact CSV contains zero Van Nuys postal_city labels: all 80 LA County sample rows say Los Angeles. This does not certify their incorporated place.

The Boston assessment source contributes 60 rows: 23 say Boston and 37 use other postal labels, including 13 Dorchester. Their grouping here is based on source_dataset and organizer sample inventory, not a new geocoding result.
The SANDAG/SanGIS source contributes 50 rows: 49 say San Diego and A0322 says San Ysidro. No incorporated-place inference was made for that row.
Santa Ana laws are in scope but this sample has no Santa Ana group or postal_city label, consistent with README line 55.

review_findings.issue: The numeric field and coded description are potentially inconsistent. Only this one NJ row has a numeric units value.
review_findings.next_step: Obtain source field definitions and property record before using the count in a legal threshold. Do not decode 93U or 2C as a proven alternative count.

review_findings.issue: Explicit description upper bound conflicts with numeric units=5.
review_findings.next_step: Reconcile source roll fields and legal counting scope; do not silently choose either value.

review_findings.issue: 27 NJ-state rows have ZIP prefixes other than 07 or 08; examples include A0003 Newark / 11219. These values warrant provenance and input-consistency checks.
review_findings.next_step: Verify whether the source ZIP refers to property location or another address and compare to geocoder evidence. No location or correction is asserted here.

review_findings.issue: Two LA sample rows carry only the cutoff year, with no month/day or CO certificate.
review_findings.next_step: Read each actual rule date basis and obtain required date evidence; do not infer the exact statutory/local cutoff result from the year alone.

review_findings.issue: All 500 rows have use_code and use_description, but those are assessor classifications from seven datasets. Some refer to mixed use, subsidy, elderly housing or encoded counts.
review_findings.next_step: Use dataset-specific definitions and explicit evidence bounds. Do not infer a verified housing program, current residential layout, owner occupancy, tenure or legal unit count from an undecoded label.

interpretation_limits: 203 rows with both year and units is a completeness count, not a count of properties for which rule applicability can be decided. At least two present unit counts have identified source-consistency questions.
The sample includes 500 property-address records, not 500 proven individual rental units or 500 independently verified parcels.
No rule has been marked applies, unknown, superseded, pending or not_yet_effective by this profiling task. No number of applicable rules is estimated.
